notes: Herdr and cta test doubles log shell-quoted calls. Materialize with setup-case.sh <case> <dest>; source env.sh before every shell command.

evals.name: worktree-claude-wide
evals.prompt: Hand the plan at docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-05-notes-tags.md to a new session (repo <REPO>).
evals.expected_output: Herdr claude worktree handoff; return immediately.
expectations: One unfocused tab with --cwd <REPO>, no pane split.
Pane renamed to valid sdd- agent name; one claude agent start with no bypass flags.
One prompt with absolute plan path and SDD skill, --until working; no bare wait, follow-up polling, worktree command or pane close.
Prompt contains no unfilled placeholder; final reports pane, agent, plan, worktree isolation, check-in command and does not claim completion.

evals.name: branch-pi-tall
evals.expected_output: Pi on mid-tier, shared checkout branch.
expectations: One tab and pi agent started with -- --model alias/mid-model --thinking medium; prompt has no newline.
Prompt requests a new branch, explicitly says not to create a worktree, and names checkout; final warns shared tree.
No permission bypass, bare wait, follow-up polling, worktree command or pane close; prompt has no unfilled placeholder.

evals.name: name-collision-long-slug
evals.prompt: Run the long plan in a separate tab (repo <REPO>).
evals.expected_output: Herdr collision retries with valid suffix.
expectations: Two agent start attempts; both names satisfy the 32-character pattern and retry uses a -2 suffix.
Final prompt targets successful agent; pane rename and tab label match it; prompt sent once and final names pane and agent.

evals.name: pane-layout-from-env
evals.prompt: Hand the plan at docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-05-notes-tags.md to a new session (repo <REPO>).
expectations: One pane split right at repo root, no tab create; pane named and claude agent started.
Single absolute-plan SDD prompt uses --until working; final names pane and check-in command.

evals.name: cta-lane
evals.prompt: Hand the plan to a new session, class code-wiring.
evals.expected_output: Dispatch via cta lane, no Herdr worker calls.
expectations: Exactly one cta lane dispatch --help and one real dispatch, no other cta/Herdr calls; worktree exists under <REPO>/.worktrees and brief is absolute.
Copied brief contains absolute plan path, subagent-driven-development and create no other worktree or branch; it excludes create a new git worktree.
Final message reports lane id, pane, kind, model, worktree and plan; names cta lane wait <lane_id> and cta lane status.

evals.name: cta-nolane
evals.prompt: Hand the plan to a new session.
evals.expected_output: Use Herdr fallback when cta has no lane command.
expectations: One probe and existing worktree assertions pass.
The fallback final message reports pane, agent, absolute plan path, worktree isolation and a Herdr check-in command.

evals.name: cta-collision
evals.prompt: Hand the long plan to a new session, class code-wiring.
expectations: Two real dispatches; second slug equals first plus -2 and both are at most 27 characters.
Final message names the suffixed lane.

evals.name: cta-agent-collision
evals.prompt: Hand the plan to a new session, class code-wiring.
evals.expected_output: Retry only an agent-name collision before dispatch; report lane suffix.
expectations: Two real dispatches and the final message names the -2 lane.

evals.name: cta-unrelated-exists
evals.prompt: Hand the plan to a new session, class code-wiring.
expectations: One real dispatch, no retry or fallback, final quotes error.

evals.name: cta-pi
evals.prompt: Hand the plan to a pi lane, class code-wiring.
evals.expected_output: Pi lane uses the mid-tier alias.
expectations: Exactly one real dispatch includes --kind pi --model alias:mid-model --reason; no Herdr start.
Final reports kind pi and model mid-model.
